verses.web: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
verses.kjv: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

verses.web: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
verses.kjv: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;

verses.web: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;
verses.kjv: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

verses.web: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.
verses.kjv: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

verses.web: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
verses.kjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

verses.web: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
verses.kjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

verses.web: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
verses.kjv: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

verses.web: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division,
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course,

verses.web: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
verses.kjv: According to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

verses.web: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
verses.kjv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

verses.web: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
verses.kjv: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

verses.web: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
verses.kjv: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

verses.web: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard, and your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
verses.kjv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

verses.web: You will have joy and gladness; and many will rejoice at his birth.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

verses.web: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
verses.kjv: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.

verses.web: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord, their God.
verses.kjv: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

verses.web: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”
verses.kjv: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

verses.web: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
verses.kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

verses.web: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you, and to bring you this good news.
verses.kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

verses.web: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak, until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”
verses.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

verses.web: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.
verses.kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

verses.web: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.
verses.kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

verses.web: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

verses.web: After these days Elizabeth, his wife, conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
verses.kjv: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,

verses.web: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
verses.kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.

verses.web: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
verses.kjv: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

verses.web: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. The virgin’s name was Mary.
verses.kjv: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.

verses.web: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”
verses.kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

verses.web: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
verses.kjv: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

verses.web: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
verses.kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.

verses.web: Behold, you will conceive in your womb, and give birth to a son, and will call his name ‘Jesus.’
verses.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

verses.web: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father, David,
verses.kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

verses.web: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”
verses.kjv: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

verses.web: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
verses.kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

verses.web: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.
verses.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

verses.web: Behold, Elizabeth, your relative, also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
verses.kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

verses.web: For everything spoken by God is possible.”
verses.kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

verses.web: Mary said, “Behold, the handmaid of the Lord; be it to me according to your word.” The angel departed from her.
verses.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

verses.web: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
verses.kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

verses.web: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
verses.kjv: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

verses.web: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

verses.web: She called out with a loud voice, and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
verses.kjv: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

verses.web: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
verses.kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

verses.web: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
verses.kjv: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

verses.web: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
verses.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

verses.web: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.
verses.kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

verses.web: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
verses.kjv: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

verses.web: for he has looked at the humble state of his handmaid. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
verses.kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

verses.web: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
verses.kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

verses.web: His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.
verses.kjv: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.

verses.web: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
verses.kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

verses.web: He has put down princes from their thrones. And has exalted the lowly.
verses.kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.

verses.web: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
verses.kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.

verses.web: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
verses.kjv: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;

verses.web: As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his seed forever.”
verses.kjv: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

verses.web: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
verses.kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

verses.web: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
verses.kjv: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

verses.web: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her, and they rejoiced with her.
verses.kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

verses.web: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of the father.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

verses.web: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”
verses.kjv: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.

verses.web: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
verses.kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

verses.web: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
verses.kjv: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

verses.web: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.
verses.kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

verses.web: His mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
verses.kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.

verses.web: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.
verses.kjv: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judea.

verses.web: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.
verses.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

verses.web: His father, Zacharias, was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
verses.kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

verses.web: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and worked redemption for his people;
verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

verses.web: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
verses.kjv: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

verses.web: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
verses.kjv: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

verses.web: salvation from our enemies, and from the hand of all who hate us;
verses.kjv: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;

verses.web: to show mercy towards our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
verses.kjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

verses.web: the oath which he spoke to Abraham, our father,
verses.kjv: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,

verses.web: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
verses.kjv: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,

verses.web: In holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
verses.kjv: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.

verses.web: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High, for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
verses.kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

verses.web: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,
verses.kjv: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,

verses.web: because of the tender mercy of our God, whereby the dawn from on high will visit us,
verses.kjv: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

verses.web: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
verses.kjv: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

verses.web: The child was growing, and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
verses.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

verses.web: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

verses.web: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
verses.kjv: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

verses.web: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.
verses.kjv: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

verses.web: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David;
verses.kjv: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

verses.web: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
verses.kjv: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

verses.web: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
verses.kjv: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

verses.web: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
verses.kjv: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

verses.web: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
verses.kjv: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

verses.web: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
verses.kjv: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

verses.web: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
verses.kjv: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

verses.web: For there is born to you, this day, in the city of David, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
verses.kjv: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

verses.web: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
verses.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

verses.web: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,
verses.kjv: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

verses.web: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
verses.kjv: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

verses.web: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said one to another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

verses.web: They came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
verses.kjv: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

verses.web: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
verses.kjv: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

verses.web: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
verses.kjv: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

verses.web: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
verses.kjv: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

verses.web: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
verses.kjv: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

verses.web: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
verses.kjv: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

verses.web: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord
verses.kjv: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

verses.web: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),
verses.kjv: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

verses.web: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
verses.kjv: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

verses.web: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

verses.web: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
verses.kjv: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

verses.web: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,
verses.kjv: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

verses.web: then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,
verses.kjv: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

verses.web: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
verses.kjv: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

verses.web: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
verses.kjv: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

verses.web: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
verses.kjv: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

verses.web: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
verses.kjv: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

verses.web: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him,
verses.kjv: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

verses.web: and Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
verses.kjv: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

verses.web: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
verses.kjv: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

verses.web: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,
verses.kjv: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

verses.web: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.
verses.kjv: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

verses.web: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

verses.web: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.
verses.kjv: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

verses.web: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.
verses.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

verses.web: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
verses.kjv: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

verses.web: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast,
verses.kjv: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

verses.web: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,
verses.kjv: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

verses.web: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.
verses.kjv: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

verses.web: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.
verses.kjv: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

verses.web: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them, and asking them questions.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

verses.web: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.
verses.kjv: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

verses.web: When they saw him, they were astonished, and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”
verses.kjv: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

verses.web: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?

verses.web: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.
verses.kjv: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

verses.web: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
verses.kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

verses.web: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
verses.kjv: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

verses.web: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
verses.kjv: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

verses.web: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
verses.kjv: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

verses.web: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.
verses.kjv: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

verses.web: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.
verses.kjv: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

verses.web: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
verses.kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

verses.web: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”
verses.kjv: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

verses.web: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.kjv: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

verses.web: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!
verses.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

verses.web: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.”
verses.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

verses.web: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”
verses.kjv: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

verses.web: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
verses.kjv: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

verses.web: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”
verses.kjv: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

verses.web: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

verses.web: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”
verses.kjv: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.

verses.web: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,
verses.kjv: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

verses.web: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,
verses.kjv: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

verses.web: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
verses.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

verses.web: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,
verses.kjv: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

verses.web: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
verses.kjv: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

verses.web: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
verses.kjv: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

verses.web: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized, and was praying. The sky was opened,
verses.kjv: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

verses.web: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form as a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”
verses.kjv: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

verses.web: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
verses.kjv: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

verses.web: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,

verses.web: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

verses.web: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

verses.web: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,

verses.web: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,

verses.web: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,

verses.web: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,

verses.web: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,

verses.web: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,

verses.web: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,

verses.web: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,

verses.web: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,

verses.web: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,

verses.web: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,

verses.web: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
verses.kjv: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.

verses.web: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
verses.kjv: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

verses.web: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.
verses.kjv: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

verses.web: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”
verses.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

verses.web: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”
verses.kjv: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

verses.web: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
verses.kjv: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

verses.web: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I give it to whomever I want.
verses.kjv: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

verses.web: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”
verses.kjv: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

verses.web: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

verses.web: He led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,
verses.kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

verses.web: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’
verses.kjv: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

verses.web: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”
verses.kjv: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.web: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”
verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

verses.web: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.
verses.kjv: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

verses.web: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.
verses.kjv: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

verses.web: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
verses.kjv: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

verses.web: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
verses.kjv: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

verses.web: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
verses.kjv: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

verses.web: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,
verses.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

verses.web: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”
verses.kjv: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

verses.web: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.
verses.kjv: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

verses.web: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
verses.kjv: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

verses.web: All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”
verses.kjv: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph’s son?

verses.web: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this parable, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

verses.web: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.
verses.kjv: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

verses.web: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.
verses.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

verses.web: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
verses.kjv: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

verses.web: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”
verses.kjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

verses.web: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.
verses.kjv: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

verses.web: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.
verses.kjv: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

verses.web: But he, passing through their midst, went his way.
verses.kjv: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

verses.web: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,
verses.kjv: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

verses.web: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
verses.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

verses.web: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,
verses.kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

verses.web: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!”
verses.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.

verses.web: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent, and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in their midst, he came out of him, having done him no harm.
verses.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

verses.web: Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
verses.kjv: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

verses.web: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.
verses.kjv: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

verses.web: He rose up from the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him for her.
verses.kjv: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. And Simon’s wife’s mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

verses.web: He stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.
verses.kjv: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

verses.web: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
verses.kjv: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

verses.web: Demons also came out of many, crying out, and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.
verses.kjv: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

verses.web: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place, and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.
verses.kjv: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

verses.web: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of the Kingdom of God to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

verses.web: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
verses.kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

verses.web: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

verses.web: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
verses.kjv: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

verses.web: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.
verses.kjv: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon’s, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

verses.web: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a catch.”
verses.kjv: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

verses.web: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night, and took nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”
verses.kjv: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

verses.web: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.
verses.kjv: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

verses.web: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came, and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.
verses.kjv: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.

verses.web: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
verses.kjv: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

verses.web: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;
verses.kjv: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

verses.web: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”
verses.kjv: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

verses.web: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.
verses.kjv: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

verses.web: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face, and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

verses.web: He stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.
verses.kjv: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

verses.web: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way, and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
verses.kjv: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

verses.web: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
verses.kjv: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

verses.web: But he withdrew himself into the desert, and prayed.
verses.kjv: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

verses.web: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

verses.web: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
verses.kjv: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

verses.web: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the midst before Jesus.
verses.kjv: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

verses.web: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”
verses.kjv: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

verses.web: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this that speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”
verses.kjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

verses.web: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?
verses.kjv: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?

verses.web: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you;’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk?’
verses.kjv: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

verses.web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins” (he said to the paralyzed man), “I tell you, arise, and take up your cot, and go to your house.”
verses.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

verses.web: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.
verses.kjv: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

verses.web: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
verses.kjv: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

verses.web: After these things he went out, and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”
verses.kjv: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.

verses.web: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
verses.kjv: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

verses.web: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.
verses.kjv: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

verses.web: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”
verses.kjv: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.

verses.web: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
verses.kjv: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

verses.web: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”
verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

verses.web: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

verses.web: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”
verses.kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

verses.web: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.
verses.kjv: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

verses.web: No one puts new wine into old wine skins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed.
verses.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

verses.web: But new wine must be put into fresh wine skins, and both are preserved.
verses.kjv: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

verses.web: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
verses.kjv: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

verses.web: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain, and ate, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

verses.web: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”
verses.kjv: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

verses.web: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he, and those who were with him;
verses.kjv: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;

verses.web: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”
verses.kjv: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

verses.web: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

verses.web: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

verses.web: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

verses.web: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up, and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.
verses.kjv: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

verses.web: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?

verses.web: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.
verses.kjv: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

verses.web: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
verses.kjv: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.

verses.web: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.

verses.web: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:
verses.kjv: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

verses.web: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;
verses.kjv: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

verses.web: Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Simon, who was called the Zealot;
verses.kjv: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alpheus, and Simon called Zelotes,

verses.web: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
verses.kjv: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

verses.web: He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.kjv: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

verses.web: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits, and they were being healed.
verses.kjv: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

verses.web: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.
verses.kjv: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

verses.web: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said, “Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the Kingdom of God.
verses.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

verses.web: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
verses.kjv: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

verses.web: Blessed are you when men shall hate you, and when they shall exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.
verses.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man’s sake.

verses.web: Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.
verses.kjv: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

verses.web: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.
verses.kjv: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

verses.web: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
verses.kjv: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.

verses.web: Woe,whenmen speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
verses.kjv: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

verses.web: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
verses.kjv: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

verses.web: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
verses.kjv: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

verses.web: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.
verses.kjv: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.

verses.web: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
verses.kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

verses.web: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
verses.kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

verses.web: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
verses.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

verses.web: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
verses.kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

verses.web: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.
verses.kjv: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

verses.web: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
verses.kjv: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

verses.web: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
verses.kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

verses.web: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
verses.kjv: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

verses.web: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”
verses.kjv: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

verses.web: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?
verses.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

verses.web: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.
verses.kjv: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

verses.web: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
verses.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

verses.web: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.
verses.kjv: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother’s eye.

verses.web: For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.
verses.kjv: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

verses.web: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
verses.kjv: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.

verses.web: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.
verses.kjv: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

verses.web: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
verses.kjv: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

verses.web: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words, and does them, I will show you who he is like.
verses.kjv: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

verses.web: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep, and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.
verses.kjv: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

verses.web: But he who hears, and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell, and the ruin of that house was great.”
verses.kjv: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

verses.web: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.kjv: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

verses.web: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
verses.kjv: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

verses.web: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
verses.kjv: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

verses.web: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
verses.kjv: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

verses.web: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
verses.kjv: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

verses.web: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.
verses.kjv: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

verses.web: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.kjv: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

verses.web: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
verses.kjv: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

verses.web: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
verses.kjv: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

verses.web: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.
verses.kjv: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

verses.web: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
