verses.kjv: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.

verses.web: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken,
verses.kjv: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

verses.web: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him, and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.
verses.kjv: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

verses.web: That servant, who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
verses.kjv: And that servant, which knew his lord’s will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.

verses.web: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.
verses.kjv: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

verses.web: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
verses.kjv: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?

verses.web: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
verses.kjv: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

verses.web: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
verses.kjv: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

verses.web: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
verses.kjv: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

verses.web: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
verses.kjv: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

verses.web: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
verses.kjv: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.

verses.web: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.
verses.kjv: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

verses.web: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?
verses.kjv: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?

verses.web: Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
verses.kjv: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

verses.web: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
verses.kjv: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

verses.web: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there, until you have paid the very last penny.”
verses.kjv: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.

verses.web: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
verses.kjv: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

verses.web: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?
verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galileans were sinners above all the Galileans, because they suffered such things?

verses.web: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
verses.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

verses.web: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them; do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?
verses.kjv: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?

verses.web: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
verses.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

verses.web: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and found none.
verses.kjv: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

verses.web: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down. Why does it waste the soil?’
verses.kjv: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?

verses.web: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it, and fertilize it.
verses.kjv: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

verses.web: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”
verses.kjv: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.

verses.web: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
verses.kjv: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

verses.web: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.
verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.

verses.web: When Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”
verses.kjv: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.

verses.web: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight, and glorified God.
verses.kjv: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

verses.web: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”
verses.kjv: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

verses.web: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath, and lead him away to water?
verses.kjv: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

verses.web: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”
verses.kjv: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

verses.web: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed, and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
verses.kjv: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

verses.web: He said, “What is the Kingdom of God like? To what shall I compare it?
verses.kjv: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?

verses.web: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and put in his own garden. It grew, and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky lodged in its branches.”
verses.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.

verses.web: Again he said, “To what shall I compare the Kingdom of God?
verses.kjv: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?

verses.web: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
verses.kjv: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

verses.web: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.

verses.web: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,
verses.kjv: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,

verses.web: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in, and will not be able.
verses.kjv: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

verses.web: When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside, and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’
verses.kjv: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:

verses.web: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
verses.kjv: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.

verses.web: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
verses.kjv: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.

verses.web: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets, in the Kingdom of God, and yourselves being thrown outside.
verses.kjv: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.

verses.web: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in the Kingdom of God.
verses.kjv: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.

verses.web: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
verses.kjv: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.

verses.web: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
verses.kjv: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.

verses.web: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.

verses.web: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet perish outside of Jerusalem.’
verses.kjv: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

verses.web: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!
verses.kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!

verses.web: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”
verses.kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

verses.web: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.

verses.web: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.
verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.

verses.web: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
verses.kjv: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?

verses.web: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.
verses.kjv: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;

verses.web: He answered them, “Which of you, if your sonor an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”
verses.kjv: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?

verses.web: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.
verses.kjv: And they could not answer him again to these things.

verses.web: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
verses.kjv: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,

verses.web: “When you are invited by anyone to a marriage feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,
verses.kjv: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;

verses.web: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.
verses.kjv: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.

verses.web: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.
verses.kjv: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.

verses.web: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
verses.kjv: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

verses.web: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.
verses.kjv: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.

verses.web: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;
verses.kjv: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:

verses.web: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”
verses.kjv: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

verses.web: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in the Kingdom of God!”
verses.kjv: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

verses.web: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.
verses.kjv: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:

verses.web: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’
verses.kjv: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

verses.web: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’
verses.kjv: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.

verses.web: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’
verses.kjv: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.

verses.web: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’
verses.kjv: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

verses.web: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’
verses.kjv: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

verses.web: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’
verses.kjv: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.

verses.web: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
verses.kjv: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

verses.web: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper.’”
verses.kjv: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.

verses.web: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,
verses.kjv: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,

verses.web: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregardhis own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.
verses.kjv: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

verses.web: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross, and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
verses.kjv: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

verses.web: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?
verses.kjv: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?

verses.web: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,
verses.kjv: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,

verses.web: saying, ‘This man began to build, and wasn’t able to finish.’
verses.kjv: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.

verses.web: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?
verses.kjv: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

verses.web: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy, and asks for conditions of peace.
verses.kjv: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.

verses.web: So therefore whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.
verses.kjv: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.

verses.web: Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?
verses.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

verses.web: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
verses.kjv: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.web: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.
verses.kjv: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.

verses.web: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
verses.kjv: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

verses.web: He told them this parable.
verses.kjv: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,

verses.web: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep, and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness, and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?
verses.kjv: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

verses.web: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
verses.kjv: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

verses.web: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’
verses.kjv: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

verses.web: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.
verses.kjv: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

verses.web: Or what woman, if she had ten drachmacoins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?
verses.kjv: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

verses.web: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost.’
verses.kjv: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

verses.web: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
verses.kjv: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

verses.web: He said, “A certain man had two sons.
verses.kjv: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

verses.web: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ He divided his livelihood between them.
verses.kjv: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

verses.web: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.
verses.kjv: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

verses.web: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.
verses.kjv: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.

verses.web: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.
verses.kjv: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

verses.web: He wanted to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.
verses.kjv: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

verses.web: But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!
verses.kjv: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

verses.web: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.
verses.kjv: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

verses.web: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’
verses.kjv: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

verses.web: “He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
verses.kjv: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

verses.web: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
verses.kjv: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

verses.web: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe, and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet.
verses.kjv: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

verses.web: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let us eat, and celebrate;
verses.kjv: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:

verses.web: for this, my son, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’ They began to celebrate.
verses.kjv: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

verses.web: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.
verses.kjv: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.

verses.web: He called one of the servants to him, and asked what was going on.
verses.kjv: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

verses.web: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’
verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.

verses.web: But he was angry, and would not go in. Therefore his father came out, and begged him.
verses.kjv: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.

verses.web: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.
verses.kjv: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

verses.web: But when this, your son, came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’
verses.kjv: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

verses.web: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.
verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

verses.web: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”
verses.kjv: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

verses.web: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.
verses.kjv: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

verses.web: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’
verses.kjv: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

verses.web: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.
verses.kjv: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

verses.web: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’
verses.kjv: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

verses.web: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’
verses.kjv: So he called every one of his lord’s debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

verses.web: He said, ‘A hundred batosof oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
verses.kjv: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

verses.web: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred corsof wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’
verses.kjv: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.

verses.web: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.
verses.kjv: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

verses.web: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.
verses.kjv: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

verses.web: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.
verses.kjv: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

verses.web: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
verses.kjv: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

verses.web: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
verses.kjv: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man’s, who shall give you that which is your own?

verses.web: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”
verses.kjv: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

verses.web: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.
verses.kjv: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.

verses.web: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

verses.web: The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of the Kingdom of God is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
verses.kjv: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

verses.web: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.
verses.kjv: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

verses.web: Everyone who divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
verses.kjv: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.

verses.web: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
verses.kjv: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

verses.web: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was laid at his gate, full of sores,
verses.kjv: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,

verses.web: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
verses.kjv: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man’s table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

verses.web: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died, and was buried.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham’s bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

verses.web: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
verses.kjv: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

verses.web: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’
verses.kjv: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

verses.web: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But now here he is comforted and you are in anguish.
verses.kjv: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

verses.web: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’
verses.kjv: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.

verses.web: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house;
verses.kjv: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father’s house:

verses.web: for I have five brothers, that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
verses.kjv: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

verses.web: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
verses.kjv: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

verses.web: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
verses.kjv: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.

verses.web: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”
verses.kjv: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

verses.web: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!
verses.kjv: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!

verses.web: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
verses.kjv: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

verses.web: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
verses.kjv: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

verses.web: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”
verses.kjv: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

verses.web: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”
verses.kjv: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

verses.web: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted, and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
verses.kjv: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

verses.web: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say, when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table,’
verses.kjv: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?

verses.web: and will not rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me, while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?
verses.kjv: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

verses.web: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.
verses.kjv: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

verses.web: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”
verses.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

verses.web: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

verses.web: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.
verses.kjv: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

verses.web: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
verses.kjv: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

verses.web: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
verses.kjv: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

verses.web: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
verses.kjv: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

verses.web: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
verses.kjv: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

verses.web: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

verses.web: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this stranger?”
verses.kjv: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

verses.web: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”
verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

verses.web: Being asked by the Pharisees when the Kingdom of God would come, he answered them, “The Kingdom of God doesn’t come with observation;
verses.kjv: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

verses.web: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, the Kingdom of God is within you.”
verses.kjv: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

verses.web: He said to the disciples, “The days will come, when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
verses.kjv: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.

verses.web: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away, nor follow after them,
verses.kjv: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.

verses.web: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of the one part under the sky, shines to the other part under the sky; so will the Son of Man be in his day.
verses.kjv: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

verses.web: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
verses.kjv: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.

verses.web: As it was in the days of Noah, even so will it be also in the days of the Son of Man.
verses.kjv: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

verses.web: They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
verses.kjv: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

verses.web: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
verses.kjv: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

verses.web: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky, and destroyed them all.
verses.kjv: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

verses.web: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.
verses.kjv: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

verses.web: In that day, he who will be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.
verses.kjv: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

verses.web: Remember Lot’s wife!
verses.kjv: Remember Lot’s wife.

verses.web: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.
verses.kjv: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

verses.web: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. The one will be taken, and the other will be left.
verses.kjv: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

verses.web: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken, and the other will be left.”
verses.kjv: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.web: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there will the vultures also be gathered together.”
verses.kjv: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.

verses.web: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
verses.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

verses.web: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God, and didn’t respect man.
verses.kjv: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

verses.web: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
verses.kjv: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

verses.web: He wouldn’t for a while, but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,
verses.kjv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

verses.web: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”
verses.kjv: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

verses.web: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.
verses.kjv: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

verses.web: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones, who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?
verses.kjv: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

verses.web: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”
verses.kjv: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

verses.web: He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.
verses.kjv: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

verses.web: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.
verses.kjv: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

verses.web: The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: ‘God, I thank you, that I am not like the rest of men, extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
verses.kjv: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

verses.web: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
verses.kjv: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

verses.web: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’
verses.kjv: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

verses.web: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”
verses.kjv: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

verses.web: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
verses.kjv: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

verses.web: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
verses.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

verses.web: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

verses.web: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
verses.kjv: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

verses.web: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one—God.
verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.

verses.web: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”
verses.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

verses.web: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
verses.kjv: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

verses.web: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Come, follow me.”
verses.kjv: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

verses.web: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.
verses.kjv: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

verses.web: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!
verses.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

verses.web: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.”
verses.kjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.web: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”
verses.kjv: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

verses.web: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
verses.kjv: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

verses.web: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything, and followed you.”
verses.kjv: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

verses.web: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for the Kingdom of God’s sake,
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God’s sake,

verses.web: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”
verses.kjv: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

verses.web: He took the twelve aside, and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.
verses.kjv: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

verses.web: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
verses.kjv: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

verses.web: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”
verses.kjv: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

verses.web: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.
verses.kjv: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

verses.web: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

verses.web: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.
verses.kjv: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

verses.web: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.
verses.kjv: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

verses.web: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
verses.kjv: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.web: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
verses.kjv: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.web: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,
verses.kjv: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

verses.web: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”
verses.kjv: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

verses.web: Immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
verses.kjv: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.

verses.web: He entered and was passing through Jericho.
verses.kjv: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

verses.web: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Zaccheus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

verses.web: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
verses.kjv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

verses.web: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was to pass that way.
verses.kjv: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.

verses.web: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”
verses.kjv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zaccheus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

verses.web: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.
verses.kjv: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

verses.web: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
verses.kjv: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

verses.web: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”
verses.kjv: And Zaccheus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

verses.web: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
verses.kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

verses.web: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that the Kingdom of God would be revealed immediately.
verses.kjv: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

verses.web: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
verses.kjv: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

verses.web: He called ten servants of his, and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’
verses.kjv: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.

verses.web: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
verses.kjv: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.

verses.web: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

verses.web: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’
verses.kjv: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

verses.web: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

verses.web: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’
verses.kjv: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

verses.web: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’
verses.kjv: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.

verses.web: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,
verses.kjv: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

verses.web: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’
verses.kjv: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.

verses.web: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth will I judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down, and reaping that which I didn’t sow.
verses.kjv: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

verses.web: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’
verses.kjv: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?

verses.web: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him, and give it to him who has the ten minas.’
verses.kjv: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.

verses.web: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’
verses.kjv: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

verses.web: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
verses.kjv: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

verses.web: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”
verses.kjv: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

verses.web: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.

verses.web: When he drew near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

verses.web: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat. Untie it, and bring it.
verses.kjv: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.

verses.web: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”
verses.kjv: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

verses.web: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.
verses.kjv: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.

verses.web: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
verses.kjv: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

verses.web: They said, “The Lord needs it.”
verses.kjv: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

verses.web: They brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt, and set Jesus on them.
verses.kjv: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.

verses.web: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.
verses.kjv: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.

verses.web: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,
verses.kjv: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;

verses.web: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”
verses.kjv: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

verses.web: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”
verses.kjv: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.

verses.web: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

verses.web: When he drew near, he saw the city and wept over it,
verses.kjv: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,

verses.web: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.
verses.kjv: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

verses.web: For the days will come on you, when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,
verses.kjv: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

verses.web: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”
verses.kjv: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

verses.web: He entered into the temple, and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
verses.kjv: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;

verses.web: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”
verses.kjv: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

verses.web: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests and the scribes and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.
verses.kjv: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

verses.web: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
verses.kjv: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.

verses.web: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,

verses.web: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”
verses.kjv: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

verses.web: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:
verses.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

verses.web: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”
verses.kjv: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

verses.web: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
verses.kjv: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

verses.web: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”
verses.kjv: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

verses.web: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.
verses.kjv: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.

verses.web: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

verses.web: He began to tell the people this parable. “A man planted a vineyard, and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.
verses.kjv: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.

verses.web: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him, and sent him away empty.
verses.kjv: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

verses.web: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him, and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
verses.kjv: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

verses.web: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him, and threw him out.
verses.kjv: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.

verses.web: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’
verses.kjv: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

verses.web: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’
verses.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

verses.web: They threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?
verses.kjv: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

verses.web: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard it, they said, “May it never be!”
verses.kjv: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.

verses.web: But he looked at them, and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the chief cornerstone?’
verses.kjv: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

verses.web: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”
verses.kjv: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

verses.web: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.
verses.kjv: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

verses.web: They watched him, and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.
verses.kjv: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

verses.web: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.
verses.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:

verses.web: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”
verses.kjv: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cesar, or no?

verses.web: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?
verses.kjv: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

verses.web: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”
verses.kjv: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Cesar’s.

verses.web: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Cesar the things which be Cesar’s, and unto God the things which be God’s.

verses.web: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer, and were silent.
verses.kjv: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

verses.web: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.
verses.kjv: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

verses.web: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up children for his brother.
verses.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

verses.web: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
verses.kjv: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

verses.web: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.
verses.kjv: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

verses.web: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.
verses.kjv: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

verses.web: Afterward the woman also died.
verses.kjv: Last of all the woman died also.

verses.web: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”
verses.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

verses.web: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry, and are given in marriage.
verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

verses.web: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage.
verses.kjv: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

verses.web: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels, and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.
verses.kjv: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

verses.web: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
verses.kjv: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

verses.web: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”
verses.kjv: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

verses.web: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”
verses.kjv: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
