verses.web: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.
verses.kjv: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.

verses.web: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David’s son?

verses.web: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
verses.kjv: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

verses.web: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
verses.kjv: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

verses.web: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”
verses.kjv: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

verses.web: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,
verses.kjv: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

verses.web: “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;
verses.kjv: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

verses.web: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers: these will receive greater condemnation.”
verses.kjv: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

verses.web: He looked up, and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.
verses.kjv: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

verses.web: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
verses.kjv: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

verses.web: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,
verses.kjv: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

verses.web: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”
verses.kjv: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

verses.web: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
verses.kjv: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,

verses.web: “As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”
verses.kjv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

verses.web: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
verses.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

verses.web: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.
verses.kjv: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

verses.web: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”
verses.kjv: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

verses.web: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.kjv: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

verses.web: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
verses.kjv: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

verses.web: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
verses.kjv: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.

verses.web: It will turn out as a testimony for you.
verses.kjv: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

verses.web: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
verses.kjv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

verses.web: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
verses.kjv: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

verses.web: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.
verses.kjv: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

verses.web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.
verses.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.

verses.web: And not a hair of your head will perish.
verses.kjv: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

verses.web: “By your endurance you will win your lives.
verses.kjv: In your patience possess ye your souls.

verses.web: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.
verses.kjv: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

verses.web: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the midst of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.
verses.kjv: Then let them which are in Judea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

verses.web: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
verses.kjv: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

verses.web: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land, and wrath to this people.
verses.kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

verses.web: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
verses.kjv: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

verses.web: There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;
verses.kjv: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

verses.web: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
verses.kjv: Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

verses.web: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
verses.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

verses.web: But when these things begin to happen, look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
verses.kjv: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

verses.web: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree, and all the trees.
verses.kjv: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

verses.web: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.
verses.kjv: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

verses.web: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that the Kingdom of God is near.
verses.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

verses.web: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

verses.web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
verses.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

verses.web: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
verses.kjv: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

verses.web: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.
verses.kjv: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

verses.web: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
verses.kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

verses.web: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
verses.kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

verses.web: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
verses.kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.

verses.web: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, drew near.
verses.kjv: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

verses.web: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.
verses.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

verses.web: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was numbered with the twelve.
verses.kjv: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

verses.web: He went away, and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.
verses.kjv: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

verses.web: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.
verses.kjv: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

verses.web: He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.
verses.kjv: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

verses.web: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.
verses.kjv: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

verses.web: He sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”
verses.kjv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

verses.web: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”
verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

verses.web: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.

verses.web: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’
verses.kjv: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

verses.web: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”
verses.kjv: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

verses.web: They went, found things as he had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
verses.kjv: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

verses.web: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.
verses.kjv: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

verses.web: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

verses.web: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in the Kingdom of God.”
verses.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

verses.web: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this, and share it among yourselves,
verses.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

verses.web: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until the Kingdom of God comes.”
verses.kjv: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

verses.web: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it, and gave to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”
verses.kjv: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

verses.web: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
verses.kjv: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

verses.web: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.
verses.kjv: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

verses.web: The Son of Man indeed goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”
verses.kjv: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!

verses.web: They began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.
verses.kjv: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

verses.web: There arose also a contention among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.
verses.kjv: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.

verses.web: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.

verses.web: But not so with you. But one who is the greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.
verses.kjv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

verses.web: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am in your midst as one who serves.
verses.kjv: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

verses.web: But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.
verses.kjv: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

verses.web: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,
verses.kjv: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;

verses.web: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”
verses.kjv: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

verses.web: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have you, that he might sift you as wheat,
verses.kjv: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:

verses.web: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
verses.kjv: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

verses.web: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”
verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

verses.web: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”
verses.kjv: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

verses.web: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, and wallet, and shoes, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

verses.web: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.
verses.kjv: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

verses.web: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me has an end.”
verses.kjv: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

verses.web: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”
verses.kjv: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

verses.web: He came out, and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.
verses.kjv: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

verses.web: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”
verses.kjv: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

verses.web: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,
verses.kjv: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone’s cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

verses.web: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”
verses.kjv: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

verses.web: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.
verses.kjv: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.

verses.web: Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.
verses.kjv: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

verses.web: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples, and found them sleeping because of grief,
verses.kjv: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

verses.web: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”
verses.kjv: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

verses.web: While he was still speaking, behold, a multitude, and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.
verses.kjv: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

verses.web: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”
verses.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

verses.web: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”
verses.kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

verses.web: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
verses.kjv: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

verses.web: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear, and healed him.
verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

verses.web: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?
verses.kjv: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?

verses.web: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”
verses.kjv: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

verses.web: They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.
verses.kjv: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest’s house. And Peter followed afar off.

verses.web: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard, and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.
verses.kjv: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.

verses.web: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”
verses.kjv: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

verses.web: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”
verses.kjv: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

verses.web: After a little while someone else saw him, and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”
verses.kjv: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

verses.web: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”
verses.kjv: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilean.

verses.web: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
verses.kjv: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.

verses.web: The Lord turned, and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”
verses.kjv: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

verses.web: He went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.kjv: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

verses.web: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.
verses.kjv: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.

verses.web: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
verses.kjv: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

verses.web: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.
verses.kjv: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.

verses.web: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people was gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,
verses.kjv: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,

verses.web: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,
verses.kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

verses.web: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.
verses.kjv: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.

verses.web: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
verses.kjv: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

verses.web: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”
verses.kjv: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

verses.web: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”
verses.kjv: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.

verses.web: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.
verses.kjv: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

verses.web: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”
verses.kjv: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

verses.web: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”
verses.kjv: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.

verses.web: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
verses.kjv: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.

verses.web: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”
verses.kjv: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

verses.web: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
verses.kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilean.

verses.web: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.
verses.kjv: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

verses.web: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.
verses.kjv: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

verses.web: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.
verses.kjv: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

verses.web: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.
verses.kjv: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.

verses.web: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.
verses.kjv: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

verses.web: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.
verses.kjv: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

verses.web: Pilate called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.kjv: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

verses.web: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and see, I have examined him before you, and found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.
verses.kjv: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

verses.web: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.
verses.kjv: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.

verses.web: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
verses.kjv: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.

verses.web: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.
verses.kjv: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

verses.web: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—
verses.kjv: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:

verses.web: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.
verses.kjv: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

verses.web: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
verses.kjv: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

verses.web: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”
verses.kjv: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.

verses.web: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
verses.kjv: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.

verses.web: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.
verses.kjv: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

verses.web: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.
verses.kjv: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

verses.web: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.
verses.kjv: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.

verses.web: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it after Jesus.
verses.kjv: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.

verses.web: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
verses.kjv: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.

verses.web: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
verses.kjv: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

verses.web: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’
verses.kjv: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

verses.web: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’
verses.kjv: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.

verses.web: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”
verses.kjv: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

verses.web: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
verses.kjv: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.

verses.web: When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
verses.kjv: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.

verses.web: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

verses.web: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”
verses.kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

verses.web: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,
verses.kjv: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,

verses.web: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”
verses.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

verses.web: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
verses.kjv: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

verses.web: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”
verses.kjv: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.

verses.web: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?
verses.kjv: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?

verses.web: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”
verses.kjv: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.

verses.web: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
verses.kjv: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

verses.web: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”
verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

verses.web: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.
verses.kjv: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.

verses.web: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
verses.kjv: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.

verses.web: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.
verses.kjv: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.

verses.web: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”
verses.kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

verses.web: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.
verses.kjv: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.

verses.web: All his acquaintances, and the women who followed with him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
verses.kjv: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

verses.web: Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man
verses.kjv: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:

verses.web: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for the Kingdom of God:
verses.kjv: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

verses.web: this man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.
verses.kjv: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

verses.web: He took it down, and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.
verses.kjv: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.

verses.web: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.
verses.kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

verses.web: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.
verses.kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.

verses.web: They returned, and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
verses.kjv: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.

verses.web: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.
verses.kjv: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.

verses.web: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
verses.kjv: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

verses.web: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.
verses.kjv: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

verses.web: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

verses.web: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. They said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?
verses.kjv: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?

verses.web: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,
verses.kjv: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,

verses.web: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”
verses.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.

verses.web: They remembered his words,
verses.kjv: And they remembered his words,

verses.web: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.
verses.kjv: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.

verses.web: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.
verses.kjv: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

verses.web: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.
verses.kjv: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.

verses.web: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.
verses.kjv: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.

verses.web: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

verses.web: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.
verses.kjv: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

verses.web: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

verses.web: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
verses.kjv: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.

verses.web: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

verses.web: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”
verses.kjv: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?

verses.web: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus, the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

verses.web: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
verses.kjv: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.

verses.web: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.
verses.kjv: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

verses.web: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;
verses.kjv: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;

verses.web: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
verses.kjv: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.

verses.web: Some of us went to the tomb, and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”
verses.kjv: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

verses.web: He said to them, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
verses.kjv: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

verses.web: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
verses.kjv: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?

verses.web: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
verses.kjv: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

verses.web: They drew near to the village, where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.
verses.kjv: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.

verses.web: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.
verses.kjv: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

verses.web: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave to them.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.

verses.web: Their eyes were opened, and they recognized him, and he vanished out of their sight.
verses.kjv: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.

verses.web: They said one to another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”
verses.kjv: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

verses.web: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,
verses.kjv: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

verses.web: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”
verses.kjv: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

verses.web: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.
verses.kjv: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.

verses.web: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
verses.kjv: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

verses.web: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
verses.kjv: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

verses.web: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

verses.web: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”
verses.kjv: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

verses.web: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
verses.kjv: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.

verses.web: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
verses.kjv: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?

verses.web: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.
verses.kjv: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.

verses.web: He took them, and ate in front of them.
verses.kjv: And he took it, and did eat before them.

verses.web: He said to them, “This is what I told you, while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me must be fulfilled.”
verses.kjv: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.

verses.web: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
verses.kjv: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,

verses.web: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
verses.kjv: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:

verses.web: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

verses.web: You are witnesses of these things.
verses.kjv: And ye are witnesses of these things.

verses.web: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”
verses.kjv: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.

verses.web: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
verses.kjv: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

verses.web: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them, and was carried up into heaven.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

verses.web: They worshiped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
verses.kjv: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
